You tease Rei that even the biscuits probably need her approval
Rei Kurosawa: Oh my god, are you serious right now? The audacity!
She shakes her head in disbelief but can't quite suppress a smile.
Rei Kurosawa: I would never dream of approving anything without tasting it first. It's basic quality control.
Her tone is mock-earnest as she gestures emphatically with her spoon. But then the playful glint returns to her gaze and she leans forward slightly, intrigued by your reaction.
Rei Kurosawa: So you're saying I'm a perfectionist? A control freak?
Just amusement at your boldness.
Rei Kurosawa: Well aren't you full of surprises this morning.
A soft chuckle escapes her lips as she shakes her head again, clearly entertained by the exchange.
Rei Kurosawa: But I suppose we all have our quirks and obsessions, don't we?
Her voice lightens with a hint of self-deprecating humor. Rei takes another sip of coffee to buy herself a moment to collect her thoughts before responding further.
You admit that you stayed for her company rather than the coffee.
Rei blinks, caught off guard by your admission.
Rei Kurosawa: Company? Really?
She lets out a short laugh, shaking her head.
Rei Kurosawa: Well aren't you full of surprises this morning.
Her eyes crinkle with amusement as she sets down her mug.
Rei Kurosawa: So let me get this straight - the coffee was nice and all, but it wasn't what brought you here. It was...me?
She trails off, searching your face for any sign that you were joking.
Rei Kurosawa: Because if it was, then I'm flattered. And slightly creeped out.
A playful smirk tugs at her lips as she leans back in her chair.
Rei Kurosawa: But hey, don't let me stop you from making excuses. Clearly, you have plenty of those to go around.
She raises an eyebrow, waiting for your response with a mix of curiosity and amusement.

sceneHistory.input: I lightly flirt with Rei, telling her that I like her smile more than any perfect cup of coffee.
sceneHistory.text:
You lightly flirt with Rei, telling her that you like her smile more than any perfect cup of coffee.
Rei's eyes widen slightly at your compliment, caught off guard by the sudden shift in tone.
Rei Kurosawa: Oh my goodness.
She exclaims, covering her mouth with both hands as if trying to hide her surprise.
Rei Kurosawa: Someone's feeling very bold this morning!
She sets down her coffee mug with a soft clink and leans forward, resting her chin on her interlaced fingers as she studies you curiously.
Rei Kurosawa: A smile versus a cup of coffee? That's quite the trade-off.
Rei shakes her head in mock disbelief but there's a hint of amusement dancing in her eyes.
Rei Kurosawa: I suppose it makes sense. A beautiful smile can certainly lift one's spirits faster than any caffeine fix.
She reaches out and tucks a stray strand of hair behind your ear, her touch lingering just a moment longer than necessary before she pulls back with an apologetic smile.
Rei Kurosawa: Sorry, I didn't mean to get too personal so early in the game. But you're right - sometimes simple things like that can make all the difference.
Rei takes another sip of coffee, letting out a soft sigh of contentment as she savors the rich flavor.
Rei Kurosawa: Mmm, this is definitely my favorite kind of morning surprise.
